description.value:
Once a shadowcaller of Nidal's Dusk Hall, you either lost faith in the Umbral Court or they in you, and you became an outcast. Turning away from the power of shadow magic was a long and difficult road, but having finally freed yourself from its influence, you now have a keen insight into how best to fight against it.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Arcana skill and the Netherworld Lore or Nidal Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Arcane Sense] skill feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
